questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF visits Dr. MIKOU in his office. After greetings, YOUSSEF says: 'I came to talk to you about the union. Do you know what it is?' MIKOU replies: 'A social club where dentists meet?' YOUSSEF, slightly annoyed, explains:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF, sighing: 'No MIKOU, it's not a social club! The union is a professional association that defends dentists' interests.' MIKOU: 'Oh really? And do they organize parties?' YOUSSEF: 'You're incorrigible!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'But what is a union really for?' Dr. YOUSSEF, taking his time, replies:
options: To sell equipment at reduced prices
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Listen MIKOU, a union serves to defend your rights, negotiate agreements with the CNSS, and represent the profession before authorities.' MIKOU: 'So basically, it's like a lawyer but for all dentists?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, in a way!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wonders: 'And who can join a union?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: Any dentist registered with the Order
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Only dentists registered with the Order can join.' MIKOU: 'So I'm eligible!' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and that's why I'm here, to convince you.' MIKOU: 'Good luck!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Is there only one union or several?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'There are several unions. In Morocco, we have AMDM, SNMD, and others.' MIKOU: 'And which one is the best?' YOUSSEF: 'The one I'm in, of course!' MIKOU, laughing: 'Of course, I should have known!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Is union membership mandatory?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, it is free and voluntary
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Membership is free and voluntary.' MIKOU: 'So I can say no?' YOUSSEF: 'Of course, but you'll be alone in the struggle.' MIKOU: 'I'm an adventurer!' YOUSSEF: 'An adventurer who risks drowning!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'What can the union do for me?' Dr. YOUSSEF lists:
options: Find you patients as a priority
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union defends your rights, negotiates agreements for you, and represents you in case of problems.' MIKOU: 'And does it pay my bills too?' YOUSSEF: 'No, that's your job!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU insists: 'How does the union protect me?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: By representing you in case of dispute
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union protects you in case of disputes, by advising and supporting you.' MIKOU: 'So if I have a problem, I call the union?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and you'll get a better response than calling your mother!' MIKOU: 'My mother is very competent!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'What is the difference between the Order and the union?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains:
options: The Order regulates, the union advocates
The union is a subsection of the Order
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The Order regulates the profession, the union defends dentists' interests.' MIKOU: 'So the Order says what to do, and the union says to do otherwise?' YOUSSEF: 'Not exactly, but that's the idea.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union negotiate with the CNSS?' Dr. YOUSSEF confirms:
options: Yes, but only at the regional level
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union negotiates with the CNSS for rates.' MIKOU: 'So if I find rates too low, I can complain to the union?' YOUSSEF: 'You can, but you have to be constructive!' MIKOU: 'I'm always constructive!' YOUSSEF: 'Oh really?'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union help me if I have a problem with a patient?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, it only deals with salaries
Only if the patient is rich
Only if you've been a member for 10 years
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union can help you in case of a dispute with a patient.' MIKOU: 'And if the patient is my uncle?' YOUSSEF: 'The union doesn't play favorites, MIKOU!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'What is union freedom?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains:
options: The right to freely join a union
The right to demonstrate in the street
The right to refuse any regulation
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Union freedom is the right to create a union and join it freely.' MIKOU: 'So I can create my own union?' YOUSSEF: 'Technically yes, but you'll need members.' MIKOU: 'I can count on my mother and my dog!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union organize training?' Dr. YOUSSEF confirms:
options: No, training is reserved for the Order
No, it only does social activities
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union organizes training.' MIKOU: 'On what?' YOUSSEF: 'On practice management, ethics, etc.' MIKOU: 'So I'll learn to manage my money?' YOUSSEF: 'If you listen, yes!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union represent me in court?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, only a lawyer can do that
Yes, it can accompany and support
No, it cannot intervene in court
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union can accompany you in court.' MIKOU: 'So if I have a trial, I call the union before my lawyer?' YOUSSEF: 'You call both, MIKOU, both!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can public sector dentists join?' Dr. YOUSSEF clarifies:
options: No, the union is reserved for private practice
Only if they also practice privately
No, they have their own union
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Public sector dentists can also join.' MIKOU: 'So they have the same rights as me?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, union freedom is for everyone.' MIKOU: 'Except for dentists who don't have jobs!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'How does the union influence laws?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union participates in consultations on laws.' MIKOU: 'So it has power?' YOUSSEF: 'Power of influence, yes.' MIKOU: 'Like my aunt Fatima at the market!' YOUSSEF: 'A bit more structured, though.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union organize demonstrations?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union can organize legal actions.' MIKOU: 'So I can demonstrate for higher rates?' YOUSSEF: 'You can, but you have to stay within the legal framework.' MIKOU: 'I'm always within the framework, YOUSSEF!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'What is a collective agreement?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains:
options: An agreement between dentists to fix their prices
A contract between a dentist and their patient
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'A collective agreement defines your working conditions.' MIKOU: 'So it's like a contract but better?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, better, because it's negotiated by professionals.' MIKOU: 'Like me?' YOUSSEF: 'No, by real professionals!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union care about students?' Dr. YOUSSEF confirms:
options: No, it doesn't care about students
Yes, it participates in their orientation
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union also helps students.' MIKOU: 'So I should have joined when I was a student?' YOUSSEF: 'You could have, yes.' MIKOU: 'No one told me!' YOUSSEF: 'You didn't ask!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union help me set up my practice?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, setting up is a personal matter
Yes, it can advise recent graduates
Only for practices in rural areas
No, only banks help with setup
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union can accompany you in setting up your practice.' MIKOU: 'Can it find me a location?' YOUSSEF: 'No, but it can advise you.' MIKOU: 'So it's like a real estate agent but cheaper?' YOUSSEF: 'Cheaper, yes, and more competent!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union deal with ethics?' Dr. YOUSSEF clarifies:
options: No, ethics are reserved for the Order
Yes, it participates in ethical reflection
No, it only deals with salary issues
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union also cares about ethics.' MIKOU: 'So it tells me what to do and what not to do?' YOUSSEF: 'It reminds you what is right and what isn't.' MIKOU: 'Like my conscience, but with a membership fee!' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'How does a union become representative?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains:
options: By the number of its members
By the size of its budget
By the number of its employees
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Representativeness comes from the number of members and elections.' MIKOU: 'So if I join, I make the union stronger?' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, every member counts!' MIKOU: 'Then I'll think about it... seriously!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union help me in case of a dispute with a patient?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, the dispute is a personal matter
Yes, it can advise and accompany
Only if the dispute is publicized
No, only a lawyer can help you
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union can advise you in case of a dispute.' MIKOU: 'And if the patient is one of my cousins?' YOUSSEF: 'The union can still help you, even if your cousin is a pain!' MIKOU: 'Do you know my family?'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'What are the benefits of joining?' Dr. YOUSSEF lists:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The benefits are numerous: defense, advice, training, network.' MIKOU: 'So basically, I pay a fee to have friends?' YOUSSEF: 'No, you pay to have professional allies!' MIKOU: 'It's the same!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union set the rates?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, rates are set by the State
Yes, it participates in convention negotiations
No, it cannot intervene on rates
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union negotiates convention rates.' MIKOU: 'So if I'm unhappy with the rates, I complain to the union?' YOUSSEF: 'You complain to the union, which complains to the CNSS.' MIKOU: 'It's a chain of complaints!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU, impressed, says: 'YOUSSEF, you've convinced me. The union is important.' YOUSSEF replies: 'So, will you join?' MIKOU concludes:
options: The union is the dentist's best ally
The union is only useful during strikes
The union is a mandatory step before retirement
questions.explanation: MIKOU: 'The union is the dentist's best ally. I'm going to join!' YOUSSEF, handing him a form: 'Finally, I was starting to lose hope!' MIKOU, signing: 'But don't expect me to be a militant like you!' YOUSSEF: 'A member is already good, MIKOU, a member...'
